sn35.20:1.1: Yo bhikkhave rūpe abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati || yo dukkham abhinandati Aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || Yo sadde || gandhe || rase || phoṭṭhabbe || dhamme abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati || yo dukkham abhinandati Aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || ||
sn35.20:2.1: Yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpe nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati || yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati Parimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || Yo sadde || gandhe || rase || phoṭṭhabbe || dhamme nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati || yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati Parimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmī
